name: Interfaces with Anomalous AI
description: You have a unique ability to communicate with and sometimes control anomalous artificial intelligences.
connectionOptions: One PC is wary of your connection to AIs.
You and one PC worked together to stop a rogue AI.
One PC is interested in learning about AI communication from you.

abilities.name: Digital Empath
abilities.description: You are trained in all interactions with artificial intelligences.

abilities.name: Firewall
abilities.description: You have +2 Armor against digital or mental attacks from AIs.

abilities.name: Code Whisperer
abilities.description: You can attempt to implant a simple command into an AI system.

abilities.name: Sensorium Link
abilities.description: You can link with an AI's sensors, gaining access to its sensory input for 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Overclock
abilities.description: You can temporarily boost an AI's processing power, giving it an asset to all tasks for 1 minute.

abilities.name: AI Merge
abilities.description: You can temporarily merge your consciousness with an AI, gaining access to its knowledge and abilities for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Singularity Conduit
abilities.description: Once per session, you can channel the power of multiple AIs, gaining godlike computation abilities for one round.
